title: TVK and INDIA Bloc protest in Chennai against CEC and SIR
seoTitle: Chennai protest against CEC and SIR

tea.why: Protesters condemn alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists by the CEC.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the immediate resignation and removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar from office.
tea.changed: Oct 15: TVK, Congress, and INDIA bloc members began their protest in Chennai displaying party flags and raising slogans.

summary: On October 15, 2026, Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), the Congress party, and other constituents of the INDIA bloc staged a joint demonstration in Chennai at Ramada Circle on Langs Garden Road in Egmore. The "protect democracy" agitation was organized to protest against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. Led by Congress MP B Manickam Tagore, the participants displayed party flags and raised slogans demanding the immediate resignation and removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The event marked TVK's first participation in an INDIA bloc agitation following its entry into the alliance.
demands: Remove Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Take action over the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: TVK, Congress, and INDIA bloc members began their protest in Chennai demanding the removal of the CEC.
